articles.title: Iran reviews U.S. proposals on its nuclear program.
p: Iran is reviewing proposals from the United States about Tehran's nuclear program.
The proposals follow months of war between Iran and the United States.
The two countries remain divided over the possible terms of an agreement.
However, discussions are taking place to prevent another military escalation in the region.
Qatar is mediating between Washington and Tehran.
Its efforts are continuing after the U.S. midterm elections.
Donald Trump also discussed de-escalation with Qatar's emir.
This contact is part of wider efforts to reduce tensions and stop renewed fighting.
Communication is also taking place through other channels.
U.S. and Iranian defense officials have communicated with each other.
Iran's foreign minister has also discussed the negotiations with Iraq's foreign minister.
These talks show that several governments and officials are involved in the diplomatic activity.
Egypt has urged the countries to use political negotiations to prevent new regional fighting.
The main goal of the discussions is to avoid another military escalation.
Iran is considering the U.S. proposals, but important differences remain between Tehran and Washington.
Qatar continues to act as a mediator while officials discuss possible terms and ways to lower tensions.

words.d: a plan or idea offered for people to consider
a country's activities involving nuclear technology
to help two sides in a disagreement reach an agreement
the process of making a dangerous situation less serious
formal discussions that try to produce an agreement
an increase in military action or conflict

o: U.S. proposals about its nuclear program
quiz.why: The text says Iran is reviewing U.S. proposals concerning Tehran's nuclear program.

quiz.why: Qatar is continuing its mediation efforts between the United States and Iran.

quiz.why: Donald Trump discussed ways to reduce tensions with Qatar's emir.

quiz.q: What is the main aim of the discussions?
quiz.why: The discussions are intended to avoid renewed fighting and another military escalation.

articles.title: Como defeated Lens by a record-equalling margin.
p: Como defeated Lens 9–1 in France on November 4, 2026.
Como produced a very strong performance and scored nine times away from home.
Lens had a very difficult match and conceded nine goals in front of their home supporters.
The result was important because of the large difference between the two teams.
The eight-goal difference equalled the biggest winning margin in the competition.
Como also became only the second team in the competition to score nine goals in one match.
Scoring so many goals away from home made the result especially notable for the Italian side.
Tasos Douvikas played a major part in Como's victory.
He scored a hat-trick, which means that he scored three goals in the same match.
His goals helped Como reach the record-equalling result.
However, the other Como players also contributed six goals during the game.
After the heavy home defeat, Lens coach Yannick Cahuzac accepted responsibility for the result.
Lens will need to recover after conceding nine times at home.
Como, meanwhile, must quickly turn its attention to its next match.
The team will face Inter in Serie A on November 8, 2026, only four days after the victory in France.
That match will give Como another important challenge after its unusual 9–1 win.

allowed the other team to score

quiz.q: What was the final score between Como and Lens?
quiz.why: Como scored nine goals, while Lens scored one.

quiz.q: Why was Como's victory especially important?
o: It equalled the competition's biggest winning margin.
It was the final match of the season.
It gave Como the Serie A title.
It was Como's first away match.
quiz.why: The eight-goal difference matched the largest winning margin in the competition.
Tasos Douvikas scored three goals in the match.
Como are scheduled to face Inter in Serie A on November 8, 2026.

articles.title: Measles cases rise sharply across the United States in 2026.
p: The United States had recorded 5,182 confirmed measles cases by November 5, 2026.
The CDC reported these figures on November 6.
Cases were found across 47 U.S. jurisdictions, showing that infections had occurred in many parts of the country.
Most infections were connected to outbreaks.
Of all confirmed cases, 4,993 were linked to 43 separate outbreaks.
This means that only a small number of cases were not known to be part of one of these outbreaks.
Vaccination status was an important factor in the figures.
People who were unvaccinated, or whose vaccination status was unknown, represented 96% of all confirmed cases.
Children and teenagers accounted for almost 60% of cases.
During 2026, 562 patients with measles were hospitalized.
Four deaths associated with the disease were also reported this year.
The number of cases in 2026 is already much higher than the total for the previous year.
During all of 2025, the United States reported 2,289 measles cases.
By early November 2026, the total was more than twice that number.
The continuing outbreaks also threaten the country's measles-elimination status.
The figures show that the disease has affected thousands of people, especially younger people and those who were not known to be vaccinated.

quiz.why: Unvaccinated or unknown-status people represented 96% of confirmed cases.

quiz.q: Which age groups accounted for almost 60% of confirmed cases?
quiz.why: Children and teenagers made up almost 60% of the confirmed cases.

quiz.q: Why is the 2026 total especially important?
o: It is lower than the 2025 total.
It only occurred in one jurisdiction.
It threatens the country's measles-elimination status.
quiz.why: The large number of continuing outbreaks threatens the United States' measles-elimination status.
